title: Deferred Tax Asset Revaluations, Costly Information Processing, and Bank Deposits: Evidence from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
eligible_reason: Single common shock: the TCJA rate cut revalues all banks' net DTAs in 2017Q4 (Period_Nr 72). Treatment is the bank's continuous DTA revaluation amount (DTARevaluation = max of l.DtA/0.35 x 0.14) interacted with post-quarter indicators (PostP_DTARev_Q417 ... Year2019); alternative versions use deciles/quartiles or a binary Treated (net DTA in 2016Q1) x period dummies, all relative to the same date. Every column has time-varying bank controls (IncomeTax OpRoA NetDtA LLP CO Size Equity Loans_to_Asset NPL or their changes) and State+Period or bank+Period FE. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: FDIC_41_clean_regressions.dta (Call Report bank-quarter panel, 525 MB, shipped). Table 4 (02_Regressions_Code.do line 514/517): reghdfe Fut_Ch_TotalDeposits_t1_w (or F_Deposits_TA_w) on PostP_DTARev_* + DTARevaluation + controls, absorb(State Period) or a(idrssd Period), cluster(idrssd); PSM subsample at line 538. Tables 5-7 split by local-newspaper presence, Engelberg measures, business/accounting expertise. Robustness at lines 493-507 with DTA deciles, quartiles, dummy and binary Treated period interactions.
estimators_reported: reghdfe continuous-intensity DiD with quarter-specific post interactions (single shock)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: All banks exposed in 2017Q4; intensity varies by DTA size.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common treatment date (2017Q4); continuous treatment intensity; time-varying controls; State rather than bank FE in the change specification
specs.fe: State, Period (bank and Period in level columns)
specs.controls: DTARevaluation IncomeTax_w OpRoA_w NetDtA_w LLP_w CO_w Size Equity_w Loans_to_Asset_w NPL_w
